2608.06953.title: Explicit, Not Longer: What Makes Epistemic Stance Survive Memory Compression
2608.06953.paper_summary: Agent memory systems compress what they store, and compression is built to drop qualifiers, so a claim's epistemic standing tends not to survive being written to memory. We ask what governs whether it does. Matched notes carry the identical claim and identical stance and differ only in where that stance sits; one model compresses both under the same budget among the same filler notes, and a blind reader that never sees the condition scores the result. Across 60 claims in seven registers, writing the stance as a labelled field rather than a bracketed aside raises retention by about 15 points on two models (37 claims to 2 on one, 30 to 8 on the other; permutation p=0.00005), and a pre-registered replication on Haiku, its prediction and decision rule committed before the run, gives +15.6 points, 38 claims to 1. Ablating the format on both models gives the same net effect from different parts: labels help on both (+9.7 and +12.8) and length helps on neither, but wording the stance as a full sentence is the largest component on one model (+12.5) and worth nothing on the other (+0.6). Either model alone would have licensed a confident and different mechanism, so we claim only the intersection: make the stance explicit, not merely longer, and expect the best way of being explicit to depend on the model. A deterministic readout with no model reproduces the two-cell direction and five of seven ablation contrasts, but not length or labels, which we therefore do not claim on one instrument. Fifty hand labels (kappa=0.75) agree on direction; we print their seven disagreements in full. We also report nine withdrawn claims, three of them former title claims of this paper.
2608.06953.paper_summary_zh: 代理記憶系統壓縮它們所儲存的內容，而壓縮的設計是為了省略修飾語，因此一個主張的認識論地位往往無法在寫入記憶後存活。我們詢問什麼因素決定它是否能存活。匹配的筆記攜帶相同的主張和相同的立場，僅在立場的位置上有所不同；一個模型在相同的預算下將兩者壓縮在相同的填充筆記中，而一個從未看到條件的盲讀者則對結果進行評分。在七個範疇中的60個主張中，將立場寫作標籤字段而非括號旁註，能使保留率提高約15個點（在一個模型中37個主張對2個，另一個模型中30個對8個；置換p=0.00005），而在Haiku上的預註冊重複實驗，預測和決策規則在運行前確定，給出+15.6個點，38個主張對1個。對兩個模型進行格式刪除，從不同部分產生相同的淨效果：標籤在兩者上都有幫助（+9.7和+12.8），而長度則在兩者上都沒有幫助，但將立場表述為完整句子是其中一個模型中最大的組成部分（+12.5），而在另一個模型中則毫無價值（+0.6）。單獨使用任一模型都會授權一個自信且不同的機制，因此我們僅聲稱交集：使立場明確，而不僅僅是更長，並預期最佳的明確方式將取決於模型。一個沒有模型的確定性讀出再現了兩個單元的方向和七個刪除對比中的五個，但不包括長度或標籤，因此我們在一個工具上不聲稱這些。五十個手動標籤（kappa=0.75）在方向上達成一致；我們完整列出他們的七個分歧。我們還報告了九個撤回的主張，其中三個是本文的前標題主張。
2608.06953.author: Alex Kwon et.al.
